name: GTN Industries Limited
about: GTN Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and export of cotton yarn in India. The company is involved in the production of fine and superfine cotton yarns, processed yarns, lifestyle garments, and double mercerized cotton products. It is also involved in the spinning and doubling of yarn business; and retail of lifestyle knitted garments, such as ready-to-wear shirts, polo t-shirts, trousers, formals, evening wear, and socks under the Cotstyle brand, as well as anti-bacterial facial masks, gloves, and arm protectors for men, women, and children under the Young Wings brand. GTN Industries Limited was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
